mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 67 degrees.

The City of Verona has announced that the Plan Commission will meet on Wednesday, November 4th, to discuss various developments including the Ardent Glen third addition and new site plans on Milky Way. Additionally, property tax bills are expected to be mailed out no later than December 15th.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also catch live music today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join the fun at Insight Wellness for Yoga this Sunday, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia this coming Monday.

The Verona Police Department issued a report regarding an incident that occurred on October 15th, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I. Officers confirmed that alcohol was not a factor in the impairment and no students were injured.
Today is the perfect day to stop by Culver's for the Turtle flavor of the day. The shop is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to head over and enjoy a scoop.
